_comment: Deployed implementations excluded from yarn check:storage-layout, keyed <network>/<DeploymentName>.
Every entry needs a reason. An entry that starts passing is reported as stale and fails the check,
so this file cannot outlive the problem it documents. Prefer fixing or annotating over adding here.
A deployment that is simply new does not belong here: it is absent from the base ref and passes on its own.

skip.bscmainnet/VAIVaultProxy: Artifact is a stub recording only abi, address and numDeployments, so there is no reference layout to compare against.
